description: Start a computer-use session against a computer-server backend and return its session_id. Pass the endpoint or rely on the configured default. Sessions are durable; stop them with computer::sessions::stop when done.

endpoint.description: Desktop to drive. Omit to drive the local machine this worker runs on (native backend, no computer-server needed). Pass a computer-server endpoint (a `ws`/`wss`/`http`/`https` url or a bare `host:port`) to drive a remote or sandboxed desktop; falls back to the configured `default_endpoint` when omitted.

os.description: Guest OS label recorded on the session and surfaced in `session-started` (`linux`, `macos`, `windows`, `android`). Omit to use the configured `os`.

Screen.description: Desktop pixel dimensions. Coordinates handed to pointer actions are in this space: integer pixels, top-left origin, 1:1 with the screenshot.

endpoint.description: The backend the session drives: `native` for the local machine, or the normalized computer-server endpoint.

screen.description: Desktop pixel dimensions; the coordinate space for `computer::act`.

session_id.description: Pass this to every other computer function.
